description: Manages records of all communications and engagements, such as meetings, calls, and emails, with partners and contacts. It allows for creation, retrieval, update, and deletion of interaction details, including participants, type, date, and associated entities.

exampleCriteria.description: Find interactions with contacts named John

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new interaction record with complete details including participants, type, and associated entities.

req.description: Interaction creation request with all required details

example_uses: Create a new meeting with UNICEF on project planning
Record email interaction with partner contacts
Add conference call with multiple stakeholders
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to create, add, record, or log a new interaction, meeting, call, or communication.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of interactions with advanced filtering, pagination, search capabilities, and access control. This endpoint supports advanced search using the `searchCriteria` parameter. To use advanced search, set `advancedSearch` to `true` and provide a JSON array of criteria in the `searchCriteria` parameter. Each criterion should be an object with `field`, `operator`, and `value` properties. For example: `[{"field": "type", "operator": "is", "value": "Meeting"}, {"field": "date", "operator": "between", "value": "2024-01-01,2024-12-31"}]`. Available fields for search include: `id`, `contactId`, `type`, `date`, `fromDate`, `toDate`, `description`, `subject`, `contactName`, `contactFirstName`, `contactLastName`, `contactEmail`, `partnerName`, `partnerStatus`, and nested fields like `contact.firstName`, `contact.lastName`, `contact.email`, `contact.title`, `contact.department`, `contact.phone`, `contact.mobile`. Operators include: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`.

request.description: Interaction filter request containing search and pagination parameters

searchCriteria.description: JSON string containing advanced search filters

searchText.description: Text to search across interaction fields (override for request.searchText)

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to search, list, filter, or browse interactions, meetings, calls, or communications.

endpoints.name: Get

example_uses: Show me details for interaction ID 123
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific interaction details by ID or when you need complete interaction information.

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or change interaction information.

endpoints.name: Delete

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, cancel, or eliminate an interaction.
